title: body
body:
## body

A native container for one manufactured part and its ordered editable history. Start an independent Body for another part; profiles and datums belong to exactly one Body. The first additive feature has no base and every later feature explicitly continues this Body’s current solid tip. Multiple Bodies share one document, but output publishes only one final solid tip. Bodies are containers, not exported solids.

Native binding: `PartDesign::Body`. Output kind: `["body"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `frame` | Right-handed Body-to-world frame, with origin in millimetres and perpendicular unit xAxis and normal. Import Placement and Body sketches remain Body-local. Assembly components use their own frame instead of this layout. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"origin":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3,"required":true},"xAxis":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3,"required":true},"normal":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3,"required":true}}}` | omitted |
